note: Every material claim below carries the URL it came from and the date it was verified. Anything not confirmed is marked UNKNOWN rather than inferred. No account was created; creating one accepts a binding agreement, which requires founder authorization.

payout_constraint_that_decides_everythin.finding: Algeria can receive PayPal payments only under PayPal's Receive Funds and Automatic Transfer Agreement, which requires linking a US bank account or a Visa credit card, holds funds 30 days, and forbids sending from balance.
payout_constraint_that_decides_everythin.consequence: Any network that pays only by PayPal is conditional on the founder having a US bank account or a Visa card that PayPal accepts, and even then carries a 30-day hold and a $5 manual-transfer fee to a card. Any network that pays by bank transfer to an Algerian account is materially stronger.
payout_constraint_that_decides_everythin.not_verified: Whether a typical Algerian-issued Visa card is accepted by PayPal for this flow. UNKNOWN.

networks.name: impact.com

country_eligibility.observed: Algeria appears in both the 'Country / Region' dropdown and the separate 'Bank Location Country' dropdown on impact.com's own publisher signup form.
country_eligibility.caveat: Presence in a form dropdown is necessary but not sufficient; approval is discretionary and the marketplace application is reviewed.

algeria_payout_usability.reason: Bank transfer is offered and Algeria is selectable as the bank location country. PayPal route inherits the PayPal Algeria constraint above.

fees.payout: UNKNOWN for an Algerian bank account; impact.com does not publish a per-country fee table on the partner help pages retrieved
fees.dormancy: $10 USD per month (direct invoicing) or GBP 25 per month (impact.com entity invoicing) after 6 months of being unpayable; non-refundable, charged until details are fixed or balance is zero

networks.tax_requirements: Electronic tax document required only when yearly earnings reach USD 2,000 with US-based brands. Non-US partners working exclusively with non-US brands submit tax details instead.
networks.categories: 6,500+ brands across retail, SaaS, travel, finance; no category restriction stated for publishers
networks.commission_structure: Brand-specific CPA, flat fee, hybrid, or pay-per-lead; set by each advertiser contract
networks.attribution: Per brand contract; partners can set minimum referral-window requirements in their own contract rules
networks.refund_reversal: Brand contract controls reversals; partners can require a reversal policy in contract requirements
networks.approval: Account creation, then a marketplace application checklist (business category, verified channel, profile) reviewed by impact.com; brands may also approve individually
networks.why: Only network of the three that is free, has a $10 threshold, and offers bank transfer with Algeria explicitly selectable as the bank country.

networks.name: Digistore24

country_eligibility.observed: Registration is advertised as free and the marketplace as open to affiliates; no country list is published on the pages retrieved.
country_eligibility.caveat: No documented Algeria exclusion was found either. Absence of evidence is not eligibility.

algeria_payout_usability.reason: SEPA and ACH are unavailable to Algeria. International bank transfer is available but has a higher minimum. PayPal route inherits the PayPal Algeria constraint.

fees.payout: fee per payout, varies by method and reseller; not quantified on the pages retrieved
fees.security_retention: 10% of earnings withheld for 60 days to fund refunds

networks.tax_requirements: VAT ID or tax number required only for Europe-based sellers using the GmbH reseller. Non-European sellers using Digistore24 Inc. are not asked for a VAT ID; US reseller uses W-8/W-9 forms.
networks.categories: 44 niches, 10,000+ offers; digital products, courses, software, services; some categories prohibited (e.g. get-rich-quick unless demonstrably serious)
networks.commission_structure: Vendor-set per offer; marketplace listing shows the rate before promotion
networks.attribution: Vendor-set per offer; not standardised across the marketplace
networks.refund_reversal: 10% security retention exists precisely because refunds reverse commissions; per-offer refund terms apply
networks.approval: Free account, then per-offer approval by vendor where required
networks.why: Free and legitimate, but the only payout rail that reaches Algeria is international transfer with a 250-unit minimum, plus a 60-day 10% retention. A first commission would be unpayable for months. Country eligibility itself is UNKNOWN.

networks.name: PartnerStack

country_eligibility.observed: Free partner account, then a Network application reviewed by PartnerStack; no country list published on the pages retrieved.

algeria_payout_usability.reason: Airwallex direct deposit's published country list does not include Algeria. Stripe's availability in Algeria was not verified this cycle (UNKNOWN). PayPal inherits the PayPal Algeria constraint, which requires a US bank or Visa card.

fees.payout_direct_deposit: varies by country and currency; variable pricing table

networks.tax_requirements: Tax information must be added before any withdrawal, regardless of provider
networks.categories: B2B SaaS and software partner programs (referral, reseller, affiliate)
networks.commission_structure: Program-specific; commonly 10-30% recurring or one-time bounties
networks.attribution: Mix of link-based attribution, lead forms, and deal registration depending on program
networks.refund_reversal: Company-set; commissions stay 'Pending approval' until the partner company reviews them
networks.approval: Network application approved by PartnerStack, then per-program application
networks.why: Good economics and a $5 threshold, but no published payout rail that reaches an Algerian bank. Applying before confirming a payout path risks earning a balance that cannot be withdrawn.

networks.name: Awin

country_eligibility.observed: Publisher applications are reviewed by a compliance team; registration is open, but country eligibility is not enumerated on the page retrieved.

algeria_payout_usability.reason: International wire is offered; the others are domestic to UK/EU/US rails.

networks.minimum_payout: GBP 20 / EUR 20 / USD 20, or the local equivalent; default thresholds are higher (50 in major currencies)

fees.signup: USD 1 refundable security deposit, payable by card, refunded at the first payment threshold or on decline

networks.tax_requirements: Tax information required before payment; bank details required
networks.refund_reversal: Per advertiser programme; Awin compliance monitors activity
networks.approval: Compliance review, typically automated in near real time, up to 2 working days if manual review is needed
networks.why: The USD 1 refundable deposit is still new expenditure, which TOTAL_NEW_SPEND=$0 forbids. The mission also designates Awin as secondary. No application was prepared.

networks.name: systeme.io (direct program, already enrolled)

country_eligibility.observed: Anyone can join, free, no application, no approval, no follower minimum.

algeria_payout_usability.reason: Wire transfer is offered alongside PayPal. Wire is the route that does not depend on PayPal Algeria's US-bank/Visa requirement; the actual wire fee to Algeria is UNKNOWN.

networks.tax_requirements: Not stated on the program page; UNKNOWN
networks.categories: SaaS: funnels, email marketing, courses, communities
networks.commission_structure: 60% of every payment, lifetime recurring (60% of USD 17 = USD 10.20/month; 60% of USD 97 = USD 58.20/month)
networks.attribution: Lifetime, permanent tagging ('last-cookie model'), explicitly not a 30/60-day window
networks.refund_reversal: Not published on the program page; UNKNOWN. Refunded subscriptions would presumably not pay commission, but this is INFERRED, not verified.
networks.approval: None; affiliate ID issued on free account creation
networks.factory_state: A tracked link already exists locally (data/affiliate_links.jsonl, program SYSTEME_DIRECT, registered 2026-09-21) and was verified ACTIVE on 2026-10-01 with attribution preserved. This is the only real tracked affiliate link in the factory.
networks.why: Free, already enrolled, real tracked link on file, $30 threshold, 60% lifetime recurring, and a real product the buyer can evaluate for free before paying.

networks.name: Amazon Associates (existing factory program)

country_eligibility.observed: affiliate_commerce/networks.py builds tagged links and gates on AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_TAG; data/affiliate_activation_pack.json records the program as the factory's single real affiliate program (ADR-149). No platform page was fetched this cycle to re-confirm the account's own country terms.

algeria_payout_usability.reason: The existing activation pack does not record a payout method for an Algerian bank account, and no platform page was fetched this cycle to confirm it.

networks.categories: Physical and digital goods sold on Amazon
networks.approval: Already part of the factory's affiliate plan (ADR-149); the only missing piece is the tag itself
networks.why: AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_TAG is unset, so all four product links render untagged and earn nothing (verified 2026-10-01, unchanged). Only the founder's own Associates account can produce the tag.

what_this_does_not_prove: That any network will approve this publisher. Approval is discretionary and UNKNOWN until applied for.
That any offer will convert. Zero real affiliate conversions exist in this factory; the 29 click rows are all null-referrer and predate a live tag.
That a wire transfer from systeme.io or impact.com will actually arrive in an Algerian bank account, or what it costs. UNKNOWN, testable only with a real payout.
Any commission figure. Projected earnings are not revenue and are not recorded as such anywhere.
